⇵FinancialWallet guides and financial learning.⌄
BUILD YOUR FINANCIAL KNOWLEDGE

Your financial journey starts with knowledge.

Learn about digital assets, market trends and risk management.

◈ Understanding your wallet⌄

A crypto wallet is a tool for viewing and managing digital assets. Learn about balances, supported networks, wallet addresses and private-key security before using any financial service.

⇩ Deposits — what to know⌄

A deposit means transferring digital assets into a wallet or platform. Always check the asset, network and destination address carefully. Sending assets to the wrong network or address may result in permanent loss.

⇧ Withdrawals — what to know⌄

A withdrawal sends assets from a platform to an external wallet. Before any real withdrawal, review network fees, processing times, destination details and applicable platform rules.

◷ Financial activity and records⌄

Keep clear records of trades, fees, deposits and withdrawals. Review transaction dates, amounts and status regularly so you can understand your financial activity and spot anything unexpected.

✦ Grow through learning and discipline⌄

Successful investing is not about trading as often as possible. Focus on understanding the market, setting realistic goals, managing risk and avoiding decisions driven by fear or excitement. More trading does not guarantee more profit.

  • Learn before you invest and only risk money you can afford to lose.
  • Use a plan, set limits and review your decisions regularly.
  • Diversify thoughtfully instead of relying on one asset.
  • Be patient, stay consistent and treat losses as a reason to reassess.
  • Be cautious of anyone promising guaranteed returns or fast profits.
ⓘ Platform information⌄

Onchain brings cryptocurrency and gold market information, trading tools, wallet features, and account services together in one streamlined platform. Explore supported markets, access the available trading interface, review your balances and activity, and manage your account in one convenient place. Platform features are provided according to the services and integrations currently enabled, with new capabilities introduced over time.

❔ Frequently Asked Questions

Search a topic or question.

🌐 General

What is Onchain?⌄
Onchain brings crypto and Gold market information, interactive charts, asset conversion tools and account features together. Explore supported markets, compare prices and review your portfolio activity in one place. Displayed trade results and conversions update account figures only; no live exchange orders or blockchain transfers are made.
Is Onchain safe to use?⌄
Use a unique password and review the security options available in your account. Keep passwords, verification codes, private keys and recovery phrases private. Additional security services will be described here as they become available.
How do I get started?⌄
Create your account, explore Markets and charts, compare supported assets with Convert, and explore the platform tools.

📈 Trading

Which trading pairs are available?⌄
Markets presents selected public crypto-market information. Asset coverage and price availability depend on the connected data providers.
How do I place a trade?⌄
Open Trade, choose a supported asset, review the market information, and select Buy or Sell. Quick Trade calculates outcomes from public market prices and adjusts the internal account balance; it does not place external exchange orders.
What are the trading fees?⌄
Quick Trade does not submit external exchange orders, so external exchange trading fees do not apply to these results. Fees for connected services are shown before a transaction is confirmed.

🔐 Account & Security

How do I enable two-factor authentication (2FA)?⌄
Visit Settings to review the security options currently available for your account. Further verification options will be announced when ready.
What if I forget my password?⌄
Choose password reset on the Register/Login page. Check spam if no email arrives.
How do I verify my account?⌄
Open Identity Verification to review the requested details and the current review status. Document images are not uploaded in this version; use the in-platform form for the available text details.

💱 Deposits & Withdrawals

How long do deposits take?⌄
The Wallet displays deposit guidance and any configured destination details. Only send cryptocurrency when an active, verified address is displayed for the exact asset and network.
What is the minimum withdrawal?⌄
Review the withdrawal details shown in Wallet before submitting a request. An approved request still requires verified payout processing before cryptocurrency is sent.
How can I deposit or withdraw funds?⌄
Open Wallet and choose Deposit or Withdraw to review the available account workflow. Only send funds to an active, verified deposit address; withdrawal requests require separate payout processing.

🧰 Technical Support

I cannot register or sign in. What should I do?⌄
Check your internet connection and sign-in details, then use password reset if needed. If you contact support, share the error message and page name, while keeping passwords and verification codes private.
Market prices or charts are not loading. Why?⌄
Refresh the Markets page and check your connection. Price updates depend on public data providers, so a short delay may occur. Contact support if the chart remains unavailable.
How do I contact technical support?⌄
Open Support and start a private chat with the Onchain team.

☷ Quick Guide

1. Create or access your account
Choose Register, enter your name and email, and follow the on-screen steps to create your personal account.
2. Explore markets and charts
Explore Markets for public price information, then review market-linked Quick Trade outcomes.
3. Review your wallet carefully
Use Wallet to review your account balances and available asset screens. External transfers and exchange orders require their respective verified services.
4. Get help safely
Tell our support team which page you were using and describe the message you saw. Keep passwords, verification codes, private keys and recovery phrases private.
